Hours for fri do not match the ficha.

findings.quote: A patient who came in last month with a cracked molar on a Thursday evening told us she was out the door pain-free within the hour.
findings.why: The ficha lists no patient testimonials on file, so this patient account is fabricated or unsupported.
findings.fix: Delete the patient anecdote and describe the emergency visit process in neutral, verifiable terms.

findings.quote: told us she was out the door pain-free within the hour
findings.why: It promises a specific outcome (pain relief within a set time) that no clinic can guarantee, which ADA advertising rules prohibit.
findings.fix: Remove the time-bound pain-relief outcome and say only that the clinic offers emergency exams when schedule allows.

findings.why: The ficha lists Thursday hours as 08:00 to 17:00, so an evening visit on Thursday contradicts the clinic's schedule.
findings.fix: Remove the evening reference or replace it with a daytime example that matches the ficha hours.

findings.quote: and on Friday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
findings.why: The ficha lists Friday hours as 08:00 to 13:00, not 08:00 to 17:00.
findings.fix: Change the Friday hours to 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.

findings.quote: If it is dirty, scrub it clean with soap and warm water before you put it back.
findings.why: ADA and IADT guidance says a knocked-out tooth should be rinsed gently with water or milk without scrubbing or using soap, since scrubbing can damage the root's periodontal ligament cells needed for reattachment.
findings.fix: Replace it with: gently rinse the tooth with milk or water, without scrubbing or using soap, and do not handle the root.

findings.quote: The ADA's [MouthHealthy page on dental emergencies](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/dental-emergencies) lists common cases and what to do.
findings.why: I cannot verify from the provided materials that this URL resolves or that the page says what the post claims, so the citation is unconfirmed.
findings.fix: Open the link, confirm the page exists and supports the sentence, and fix or remove the link if it does not.

findings.quote: Dental emergencies rarely happen at a convenient time.
findings.why: This generic opener is a stock phrase that adds no specific information for readers.
findings.fix: Open with a concrete scenario or the specific first step the reader needs.
